admission.justification: A future diff optimization must not hide neighboring marked context when revealing a collapsed-run mark.

applicability: The recorded reviewer/reader 3 choice of MIK-R67@v2 rule18, or the explicit F07 resource ruling for one-spilled-history.
conditions: Expand the whole collapsed run when revealing a mark inside it.
The approved choice shows the hunk in its full run context and prevents neighboring marks being hidden.
exclusions: No whole-file expansion or extra source bytes beyond the admitted full-file provider is promised.
This is a source-bound future boundary, not a fresh runtime, visual, suite or independent MEMORY verdict.
statement: A mark inside a collapsed run expands the whole run. The hunk is shown in its full context, and no neighbouring mark is hidden.
